hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.cts|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.jsonc|*.md) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt" --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/oxlint" --type-aware --deny-warnings "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
[ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(bun run typecheck 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
